title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities, but their high pretraining cost raises a practical sustainability question: does this upfront investment pay off over a full deployment lifecycle, compared to supervised standalone models that must be periodically retrained? We model the cumulative carbon cost of different approaches across a realistic industrial scenario: Chronos-2 amortizes its pretraining cost within months for large or frequently queried deployments, but a classical model remains cheaper indefinitely for small or rarely queried ones. For cases where reducing the TSFM's own cost matters, we show that removing a single encoder block (7.9% of parameters) via a gradient-free pruning criterion yields a consistent 6 to 9% reduction in FLOPs, CO2 emissions, and latency, at essentially no cost to zero-shot forecasting performance across a 25-task benchmark.

translated_title: 时间序列基础模型部署与预训练的可持续性：从碳足迹分析到基于剪枝的减排方案
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）具有强大的零样本预测能力，但其高昂的预训练成本引发了一个实际的可持续性问题：与必须定期重新训练的有监督独立模型相比，这笔前期投资能否在整个部署生命周期中得到回报？我们在一个现实的工业场景中对不同方法的累计碳成本进行了建模：对于大规模或高频查询的部署，Chronos-2可在数月内摊销其预训练成本；而对于小规模或低频查询的部署，经典模型始终保持更低的成本。对于需要降低TSFM自身运行成本的情形，我们证明，通过无梯度剪枝准则移除单个编码器块（占参数的7.9%），可在FLOPs计算量、CO2排放和延迟方面实现一致的6%至9%的降低，同时在包含25个任务的基准测试中几乎不影响零样本预测性能。
tldr: 该论文通过建模不同部署场景下的累计碳成本，评估了时间序列基础模型相比需定期重训的传统模型的可持续性，并证明仅通过无梯度剪枝移除单个编码器块，即可在几乎不损失零样本预测性能的前提下减少6%-9%的计算量、碳排放和延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper models the cumulative carbon cost of TSFM deployment versus periodically retrained standalone models across realistic industrial scenarios, and demonstrates that gradient-free pruning of a single encoder block (7.9% of parameters) consistently reduces FLOPs, CO2 emissions, and latency by 6-9% with essentially no loss in zero-shot forecasting performance.
